name: proof-worker-gate
cmd: set -euo pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/install.log" 2>&1; bunx tsc -p research/bapa/tsconfig.proof-worker.json > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/types.log" 2>&1; bun test core/proof-output.test.ts research/bapa/proof-worker.test.ts research/bapa/proof-capture.test.ts research/bapa/proof-codec.test.ts research/bapa/proof-projection.test.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/tests.log" 2>&1; set +e; bun research/bapa/proof-worker.ts --only consensus > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/worker.log" 2>&1; capture_exit=$?; set -e; test "$capture_exit" -eq 2; if bun research/bapa/proof-worker.ts --only consensus --work 1 --out "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/tiny-work" > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/tiny-work.log" 2>&1; then exit 31; fi; bun research/bapa/proof-worker-gate.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/smoke.json"; printf '%s\n' 'feat(research): retain single-call BAPA search closures' > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/commit-message.txt"; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/commit-message.txt" > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/commitlint.log" 2>&1
